name: libxsmm-panel32-subs-bne-k-loop-control
hypothesis: Apply the selected counter rewrite to Lpanel32_368, the single active panel32 compute loop. The recommendation's reference to two compute loops does not match this path; the two inactive full512 loops remain unchanged. SUBS/B.NE retains 512 iterations, pointer bounds and per-output FP32 update order. Instruction count remains two; no speedup is established. The historical SUBS/B.NE experiment modified full512, so this active-panel32 change is distinct from supplied measured sources. ABI, SME transitions, stack, timed packing/allocation, stores, fallback and all BSD notices remain unchanged. No tools or tests were run. Assembly acceptance, all 48 public cases at tolerance 0.002, ten validation reports, ten alternating fresh imported controls, the fixed promotion gate and holdout validation remain required under unchanged power settings.
